# CLI: Monitor

## create-channel

Kind: Write.

Pass Slack and Webhook addresses and all Headers through --cli-input-json
file://channel.json. Email, Slack, SMS, and Telegram can validate an OTP
supplied with its reference. Webhook refuses OTP fields. Channel credentials are
masked before rendering or querying.

| Flag                                    | Type                      | Required |
| --------------------------------------- | ------------------------- | -------- |
| `--name`                                | `string`                  | yes      |
| `--type`                                | `string`                  | yes      |
| `--address`                             | `string`                  | yes      |
| `--otp-ref`                             | `string`                  |          |
| `--otp`                                 | `string`                  |          |
| `Headers` (via `--cli-input-json` only) | `[]monitor.ChannelHeader` |          |

```sh
greennode monitor create-channel --name <name> --type Webhook --cli-input-json file://channel.json
```

| `--failed-locations`                          | `int`                        |          |
| `--in-alarm-channel-id`                       | `stringArray`                |          |
| `--undetermined-channel-id`                   | `stringArray`                |          |
| `--up-channel-id`                             | `stringArray`                |          |

| `Query` (via `--cli-input-json` only)         | `map[string]string`          |          |

## create-log-alarm

Kind: Write.

The exact name search must finish every page with consistent counts and
identities before creating the alarm. A duplicate name exits 2. Supply
QueryString and a JSON Filter together, or leave both empty for a match-all
query. A nonfinite threshold exits 2 before requests. Without --no-wait the SDK
polls for ACTIVE for up to 120 seconds. An unconfirmed write must be reconciled
by reading before another create.

| Flag                                   | Type                      | Required |
| -------------------------------------- | ------------------------- | -------- |
| `--name`                               | `string`                  | yes      |
| `--log-project-id`                     | `string`                  | yes      |
| `--threshold-value`                    | `*float64`                | yes      |
| `--description`                        | `string`                  |          |
| `--severity`                           | `string`                  |          |
| `--query-string`                       | `string`                  |          |
| `--threshold-type`                     | `string`                  |          |
| `--condition`                          | `string`                  |          |
| `--time-frame`                         | `int`                     |          |
| `--group-by-field`                     | `string`                  |          |
| `--agg-field`                          | `string`                  |          |
| `--agg-type`                           | `string`                  |          |
| `--in-alarm`                           | `[]string`                |          |
| `--ok`                                 | `[]string`                |          |
| `--no-wait`                            | `bool`                    |          |
| `Filter` (via `--cli-input-json` only) | `jsontext.Value`          |          |
| `Resend` (via `--cli-input-json` only) | `*monitor.LogAlarmResend` |          |

```sh
greennode monitor create-log-alarm --name <name> --log-project-id <log-project-id> --threshold-value <threshold-value>
```

## get-alarm

Kind: Read.

A missing alarm exits 1, not 4: the API answers an unknown ID with a 500, not a
404, so this command never reports the NotFound error class.

| Flag         | Type     | Required |
| ------------ | -------- | -------- |
| `--alarm-id` | `string` | yes      |

```sh
greennode monitor get-alarm --alarm-id <alarm-id> --query Alarm
```


## get-check-alarm

Kind: Read.

Reads the current alarm and its location states through the check's
HistoryAlarmID. An empty alarm reference is NotFound (exit 4). An unknown
definition can return server error 500 (exit 1). A check's Status reports
whether it runs. MonitorStatus reports its alarm state.

| Flag         | Type     | Required |
| ------------ | -------- | -------- |
| `--check-id` | `string` | yes      |

```sh
greennode monitor get-check-alarm --check-id <check-id> --query Alarm
```

## get-notification-quota

Kind: Read.

--kind accepts Email or SMS, case insensitively. Reads quota identity, status,
expiry, and AutoRenew. Table and text timestamps show UTC. A missing quota is
NotFound (exit 4).

| Flag     | Type     | Required |
| -------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--kind` | `string` | yes      |

```sh
greennode monitor get-notification-quota --kind Email --query Quota
```

## get-notification-quota-usage

Kind: Read.

--kind accepts Email, case insensitively. Reads message consumption and
descriptions. A missing quota is NotFound (exit 4). SMS usage is refused before
requests.

| Flag     | Type     | Required |
| -------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--kind` | `string` | yes      |

```sh
greennode monitor get-notification-quota-usage --kind Email --query Usage
```

## get-quota-usage

Kind: Read.

Reads composite usage and freeEmailQuota/freeSmsQuota. UnmodeledKinds names
nonempty usage arrays whose item shapes are unknown; they contribute no invented
totals. Alert emails consume Email quota usage, while the synthetic email
counter can stay zero. Allowances depend on the account and package. See Monitor
Quotas.

No fields.

```sh
greennode monitor get-quota-usage --query Usage
```

## get-synthetic-quota

Kind: Read.

Reads quota identity, status, expiry, AutoRenew, and package detail. Table/text
timestamps show UTC and absent prices show unknown; JSON preserves SDK values.
ChannelLimits preserves null versus explicit zero; legacy integer limits
collapse null to zero. Synthetic quota expiry stops checks. A missing quota is
NotFound; check monitor quota-status --kind synthetic and use monitor
create-synthetic-quota for a free quota. Auto-renew enable sends once; the
observed free Basic quota returned BadRequest (400, exit 1). Disable remains
unavailable. Guarded free create, recovery, renewal, and destructive delete are
available. See Monitor Synthetic Quota.

No fields.

```sh
greennode monitor get-synthetic-quota --query Quota
```

## get-synthetic-quota-usage

Kind: Read.

Reads synthetic usage counters and their descriptions. Alert emails consume the
Email quota, rather than the synthetic email counter. See Monitor Quotas.

No fields.

```sh
greennode monitor get-synthetic-quota-usage --query Usage
```

## list-check-alarm-history

Kind: Read.

--start and --end are RFC 3339 strings. End defaults to now and Start to 24
hours before End. Invalid, empty, or reversed ranges at millisecond precision
exit 2 before requests. --location-id selects one probe location. Items contains
only returned transitions: paging and truncation are unknown, and no state at
the window start is supplied. Empty Items proves neither that no transition
occurred nor that an alarm exists. Use get-check-alarm for current state.

| Flag            | Type     | Required |
| --------------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--check-id`    | `string` | yes      |
| `--start`       | `string` |          |
| `--end`         | `string` |          |
| `--location-id` | `string` |          |

```sh
greennode monitor list-check-alarm-history --check-id <check-id>
```

## list-check-response-times

Kind: Read.

HTTP checks only. --start and --end are RFC 3339. --end defaults to now and
--start to 24 hours before --end. The window is at most 24 hours. Values are
average response times in milliseconds per probe location, in 5-minute buckets
for a 24-hour window. Use get-check-alarm for location names.

| Flag         | Type     | Required |
| ------------ | -------- | -------- |
| `--check-id` | `string` | yes      |
| `--start`    | `string` |          |
| `--end`      | `string` |          |

```sh
greennode monitor list-check-response-times --check-id <check-id>
```

## list-notification-packages

Kind: Read.

--kind accepts Email or SMS, case insensitively. Prices are in VND; absent
prices print unknown in table/text and null in JSON. A zero-price package is not
an automatic allowance. Email and SMS quota reads, quotes, and orders are
available; SMS usage refuses locally.

| Flag     | Type     | Required |
| -------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--kind` | `string` | yes      |

```sh
greennode monitor list-notification-packages --kind Email
```

## list-synthetic-packages

Kind: Read.

Lists class options, class unit packages, and v1 packages separately, with their
own identifiers. Class Packages shows unit API, location, tier, and monthly unit
price. Options join only by exact package ID within the class. The v1 catalog
cannot establish class option prices. Disabled classes stay visible.
AutoRenewEligible is unknown without provider evidence. Settings periods are
shown separately. Known free periods are capped by the free maximum. Read-only
settings allow this read.

No fields.

```sh
greennode monitor list-synthetic-packages
```

## quota-status

Kind: Read.

--kind optionally selects synthetic, email, or sms, case insensitively. Omitted
means all three. Returns a sequential snapshot with one UTC AsOf. Synthetic uses
quota, detail, class catalog, and settings reads, with detail price and class
and an unknown package name. Notification price is the current list price.
Missing quotas produce none rows and exit 0. Failed rows print partial output,
ignore --query, and exit 1 as QuotaStatusIncomplete. Null means unknown. False
and zero remain distinct. RenewWindowOpen describes the catalog-eligible free
Synthetic timing window. NextSafeCommand suggests renewal inside the free window
or recovery for expired free trash, only with POC and auto-renew off. Suggested
writes require explicit guards from a fresh read. Table and text show time left
in days, hours, and minutes. Rows without errors have a blank Error cell.
Read-only settings allow this read.

| Flag     | Type     | Required |
| -------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--kind` | `string` |          |

```sh
greennode monitor quota-status --kind synthetic
```

## quote-create-log-project

Kind: Read.

Ignores MaxPrice and NoWait even when an inline --cli-input-json value sets
them: both govern only create-log-project's own price ceiling and wait, never
this read, which neither orders anything nor waits. Prices are VND totals that
include VAT; the API gives no VAT breakdown.

| Flag                                     | Type      | Required |
| ---------------------------------------- | --------- | -------- |
| `--name`                                 | `string`  | yes      |
| `--description`                          | `string`  |          |
| `--class`                                | `string`  |          |
| `--retention-days`                       | `int`     |          |
| `--gb-per-day`                           | `int`     |          |
| `MaxPrice` (via `--cli-input-json` only) | `float64` |          |
| `NoWait` (via `--cli-input-json` only)   | `bool`    |          |

```sh
greennode monitor quote-create-log-project --name <name>
```

## quote-create-notification-quota

Kind: Read.

Estimates one month of Email or SMS capacity without ordering. Omitting
--package-id selects the unique zero-price package. An existing quota is
refused. MaxPrice and NoWait are ignored. Prices are in VND. Email pre-VAT
treatment is inferred and SMS VAT treatment is unverified. GuardPrice is the
higher of list and quote prices.

| Flag                                     | Type      | Required |
| ---------------------------------------- | --------- | -------- |
| `--kind`                                 | `string`  | yes      |
| `--package-id`                           | `string`  |          |
| `MaxPrice` (via `--cli-input-json` only) | `float64` |          |
| `NoWait` (via `--cli-input-json` only)   | `bool`    |          |

```sh
greennode monitor quote-create-notification-quota --kind Email
```

## quote-create-synthetic-quota

Kind: Read.

Estimates one month of a selected free package after verifying quota absence and
eligibility in the class catalog. Uses class unit prices. Paid offers are
refused. MaxPrice and NoWait are ignored. Read-only permits this quote.

| Flag                                     | Type      | Required |
| ---------------------------------------- | --------- | -------- |
| `--class-id`                             | `string`  | yes      |
| `--package-id`                           | `string`  | yes      |
| `--quantity`                             | `int`     | yes      |
| `MaxPrice` (via `--cli-input-json` only) | `float64` |          |
| `NoWait` (via `--cli-input-json` only)   | `bool`    |          |

```sh
greennode monitor quote-create-synthetic-quota --class-id <class-id> --package-id <package-id> --quantity <quantity>
```

## quote-renew-synthetic-quota

Kind: Read.

Estimates one month from the active quota and its identity-checked detail.
ExpectedEndTime must be RFC 3339 and match the quota expiry. MaxPrice,
MaxDaysLeft, and NoWait are ignored. Read-only permits this quote.

| Flag                                        | Type      | Required |
| ------------------------------------------- | --------- | -------- |
| `--expected-end-time`                       | `string`  | yes      |
| `MaxPrice` (via `--cli-input-json` only)    | `float64` |          |
| `MaxDaysLeft` (via `--cli-input-json` only) | `int`     |          |
| `NoWait` (via `--cli-input-json` only)      | `bool`    |          |

```sh
greennode monitor quote-renew-synthetic-quota --expected-end-time <expected-end-time>
```
